name: Pog.pet
one_liner: A personalized physical pet product that makes the customer’s pet come alive on their phone and becomes a persistent Pog actor.
core_thesis: Personalized pet gifting has existing emotional demand on Etsy. A stronger product combines the physical artifact with a portable 3D/AR pet actor. The initial purchase can become the acquisition event for a persistent digital identity that later participates in Pogtown, games, clips and messages.
why_now: Personalized pet goods already sell; browser 3D/AR and generative asset pipelines can make the output dramatically more experiential.
job: Turn my pet into a memorable personalized physical + animated digital gift.
distribution: Etsy first, short listing videos, then pog.pet direct.
moat: Reusable pet-actor pipeline and persistent identity/world integration rather than one-off video generation.
falsifiers: AR adds no willingness to pay over simpler pet videos.
Asset generation/rigging cannot be automated cheaply enough.
Etsy listing distribution is insufficient to acquire buyers.

success_definition: All 12 checkpoints PROVEN on live evidence, with no unresolved critical H-task or security gate.

repo_binding.polling: GitHub snapshots are implementation evidence only; checkpoint proof comes from validator receipts.

software_substitution_test.counterfactual: OpenAI/platform vendors ship perfect software for every reproducible feature in this project tomorrow.
software_substitution_test.rationale: Generation gets commoditized. The durable object is a customer-owned persistent pet identity tied to purchases, physical artifacts and later world interactions.

underengineer.rule: Choose the earliest real-world event that increases controlled scarce state; build only its prerequisites plus safety and verification.
underengineer.scarce_state_target: Create the first paid persistent pet identity
underengineer.minimal_live_product: Sell one simple personalized pet product: customer uploads pet photo, receives a durable web actor/animation link with persistent pet ID, optionally printed as a card. AR and complex rigging wait.

steps.action: Publish one offer and take one real paid order
Create persistent pet ID bound to customer/order/photo provenance
steps.acceptance: Identity readback is stable across sessions.

steps.action: Render one charming browser animation from the durable link
steps.acceptance: Customer can open it without proprietary AR dependency.
Outcome links back to identity and order.

underengineer.graduation_rule: 10 paid persistent pet identities with evidence customers value the persistent experience, not merely the image transformation.
underengineer.kill_or_rethink_rule: If buyers only value a one-off generated video and show no interest in persistent identity/physical linkage, keep it as simple commerce or stop.
underengineer.project_manager_invariant: A feature may enter NOW only if it is necessary to reach the first real moat event, required for safety/verification, or empirically unblocks that path.
underengineer.observation_pause: After the first live moat event, stop expanding and inspect customer/outcome evidence before choosing the next feature.

full_roadmap_policy: The original checkpoint ladder is a capability library, not default build order. UNDERENGINEER chooses the live minimum path.
